risks.risk: The digital display may be non-functional or have a dead battery.
risks.proof: A video showing the display powered on and showing a heart rate or distance reading.

risks.risk: The pedals may be loose, worn, or have a broken chain.
risks.proof: A video of the bike in motion showing the pedals turning and the chain engaging.

risks.risk: The seat cushion may be worn or torn.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the seat cushion.

risks.risk: The handlebar controls may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the speed and resistance controls being used.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the bike powered on and moving to test the display and pedals.
Close-up photo of the seat cushion to check for tears or wear.
Video showing the resistance and speed controls working.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
